concepts.label: underlay
concepts.gloss: A binding representing the network underlay that carries a specific VPN/IP service.

concepts.label: attachment
concepts.gloss: An attachment point (interface) where a service connects to the network and is associated with a VLAN.
concepts.example: att-NY-SVC42 attaches to SVC-42 and bears C-VLAN 100.

concepts.label: rate
concepts.gloss: The committed information rate (CIR) guaranteed for the service.

concepts.label: latency
concepts.gloss: The latency tier assigned to the service, describing the expected delay.

concepts.label: protection
concepts.gloss: The protection policy for the service, indicating resilience against a single path failure.

concepts.label: grade
concepts.gloss: A service-class label used to categorize service quality (gold, silver, bronze).

concepts.label: vlan
concepts.gloss: The VLAN encapsulation tag used on an attachment to isolate and carry the service traffic.

concepts.label: service
concepts.gloss: An IP/VPN service instance that rides an underlay and attaches at an attachment point.
